rules.text: Potholes, craters and damage on main arterial roads, ring roads, flyovers and bus routes with heavy traffic.
Potholes and damage on internal lanes, residential streets, cross roads and footpaths.
Garbage not collected, missed door-to-door pickup, overflowing bins.
Illegal dumping, construction debris, large piles of waste and dead animals on the road.
Street lamp not working, flickering light, dark road at night.
Burst pipes, water gushing onto the road, flooding and major leaks that waste large amounts of water.
Slow leaks, low water pressure, dirty or discoloured water, no supply to a house.
